name: border-shine
title: Border Shine
description: A glass edge that catches the light: a masked inset highlight whose angle follows the pointer, or the arrow keys. Wraps any card or button.
author: Jhey <https://codepen.io/jh3y>
docs:
Installed `BorderShine` (and its `BorderShineGlyph`) in `components/ui/`, plus `useReducedMotion` in `hooks/`. Wrap any card or button: `<BorderShine as="button" type="button" aria-label="Weather" className="size-16"><BorderShineGlyph /></BorderShine>`. Give it a size, and a radius with `squircle={false}` and a `rounded-*` class.

The edge is a masked 1px inset shadow whose gradient angle follows the pointer anywhere on the page, and the arrow keys while the element or a button inside it has focus; `angle` sets where it rests (and where it sits under reduced motion). The glass fill, the highlight and the glyph's colors are `--border-shine-from`, `-to`, `-highlight`, `-sun`, `-sun-stroke`, `-cloud` and `-cloud-stroke`.

The fill needs something behind it to blur and saturate, so put it over an image or a gradient. Ported from jh3y's CodePen "masked inset border shine" (MIT, copyright 2026 Jhey); the license text is in the file.
